text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. To report on the café operation in the matter of a boulevard café area located at 1312 St. Clair Avenue West, Nairn Avenue flankage.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Revoked the continuance of a boulevard café permit located at 1312 St. Clair Avenue West, Nairn Avenue flankage.
